name: The founders' own performance and departure, a founder as a flag's subject, the founders' absorber, the founders as the leads' check-in holders and as an interim domain holder as founder loads, and the operating agreement's rule beneath every reserved class on the S15 page
text_content:
Routed to: S16 (86ajgmjz6)

Session 15 recorded nothing about Brandon's or Dominic's performance, work, or departure and marked every place the page touches a founder as Session 16's. Session 16 inherits: a founder's own departure, which the record never describes and which the operating agreement governs before any mechanism on the S15 page does; a founder as the subject of a non-negotiable flag, for which Session 15 designed nothing beyond routing it here with the operating agreement; the absorber above the founders, since Session 15 read a lead's failure as absorbed by the center in the partners' review and stopped there; the founders as the leads' check-in, review, career conversation, window block, and flag conversation holders under the team's reading held on 86akhb2jg, and the pairing partner as the interim holder of a domain's check-ins when a lead seat is open, both as founder loads read at the reset and never as interiority; the founders' completion of the departure module's lead and founder half pre-opening beside the coaching, review, and performance modules; counsel's question on whether a founder holding a lead's check-in or a domain in an interim changes anything about the founders' or the leads' employment form; and the interim two-partner rule and the operating agreement's voting or deadlock rule beneath the decision about staying and the reduction's Class A decision. This extends 17tn048qfp3, 17tn048qepd, 17tn048qcjz, 86akhpvub, 86akht3e4, 86akh5uy9, and 86akh2qzy and does not repeat them. Normal.

Filed by Session 15 of the Scaling People translation program. Session task 86ajgmjpw. Reasoning lives on the S15 page of the Sŏn Operating System doc 2ky45bmy-17253.
